title: Implement Robust Error Handling for Route Handlers
description: This feature introduces a centralized error handling mechanism for route handlers, providing a more robust and reliable way to manage errors and exceptions. It will allow developers to define custom error handlers and provide informative error messages. This improvement will significantly enhance the overall stability and user experience of applications built with yantraverse.
testCases: Test error handling for synchronous route handlers
Test error handling for asynchronous route handlers
Test error handling for middleware functions
acceptance: Error handling mechanism should catch and log errors, and return user-friendly error messages to the client. Custom error handlers should be callable and override default error handling behavior.
reason: Implementing robust error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it directly impacts the reliability and maintainability of applications built on top of it.
